projectName: Platypus plush restuff and new paw clip
title: Lumpy platypus plush restuffed, with a new clip for his paws
description: This platypus plush's old stuffing had broken down into small clumps. He was deep cleaned, the old stuffing was removed and replaced with fresh fill, and the worn clip on his paws was replaced with a new one.
itemDetails: This is a large platypus plush with dark grey fleece, a cream sherpa underside, and soft brown bill and feet. A clip on his front paws lets them fasten together for a hug.
repairDetails: The original stuffing inside this platypus had aged and clumped into tiny pieces, leaving him lumpy and flat. He was given a deep clean, and all of the old stuffing was removed. The clip on his paws was replaced with a new one, sewn in on the sewing machine. He was then refilled with fresh stuffing and sewn closed, so he is soft and evenly filled again.
